title: A Falsified Bar-Instability Criterion Reveals an Independent Disk-State Parameter from EFC-Modified Disk Kinematics
abstract: This Stage-1 empirical test falsifies an EFC-modified Toomre-Q bar-instability criterion on SPARC galaxies (AUC 0.22–0.31 within the physically allowed ζ range), closing the bar-prediction track. In the same data, the minimum EFC-Q (Πmin) within the disk window emerges as a robust disk-state proxy, correlating strongly with stellar surface density (negative) and gas fraction (positive), with replication on an independent xGASS sample.
